uncited_numbers flags for '2', '9', '22', '2013' are false positives: '2' is 'Class 2', and 9/22/2013 are date fragments of CRL dates that are cited (10/22/2013, 09/15/2016).
uncited_numbers flags for '505', '200655', '18' are false positives: 505(b)(2) is a program designation, 200655 is the app number, and 18 is part of the drug name 18F-FDOPA.
